business_problem: vivo wanted its BlueLM-powered phone assistant to answer general questions while also retrieving current and authoritative information without forcing users to open browsers or other apps.
solution_summary: vivo integrated Baidu AI Cloud's Qianfan platforms into the BlueLM and BlueLM Assistant stack so its phone assistant could mix model reasoning with fresh web knowledge. The core architectural change was the introduction of a retrieval-augmented generation path connected to Baidu Search. When users ask about weather, stocks, exchange rates, policy changes, travel or current affairs, BlueLM Assistant can invoke Baidu Search-sourced retrieval components rather than relying only on a static device model. The result is a hybrid design in which vivo keeps its own BlueLM device-side experience and assistant persona, while Baidu provides model services and the RAG pathway that grounds answers on recent information with source traceability. The same collaboration also explores a broader phone-agent ecosystem, positioning the assistant as a front door for more specialized mobile intelligence rather than only a chat interface.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports the large-model integration and optimization work behind BlueLM Assistant.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Application Platform
solution_components.role: Packages the application workflows that connect assistant requests to model services.

solution_components.name: RAG with Baidu Search
solution_components.role: Retrieves current, sourceable information for time-sensitive assistant questions.

solution_components.name: BlueLM Assistant
solution_components.role: Provides the user-facing intelligent-assistant experience on vivo phones.

data_flow: Phone-assistant questions are routed through BlueLM Assistant; when a topic needs timely information, RAG with Baidu Search retrieves fresh results, which the model stack summarizes and returns inside the phone assistant without forcing a browser handoff.
business_outcome: vivo upgraded its assistant from a general-purpose model interface to a real-time service surface that saves users time, improves accuracy and strengthens the brand's AI-phone positioning.
architecture_clues: The design explicitly uses RAG components connected to Baidu Search
The assistant delivers results without requiring users to switch into a browser
The collaboration also explores broader mobile-agent ecosystems
